senses.gloss:
The names of divisions of day or night ending with Locative -7th-case-affix are compounded with words ending with affix क्त and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

Terms: समास-तत्-पुरुष

A word ending with the affix क्त and not having the negative augment नञ् is compounded with the same word ending with the affix क्त but which is distinguished from the former, by having the augment नञ् and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

Terms: समास-तत्-पुरुष

A word ending with sixth case-affix is not compounded with a word ending with the affix क्त , when the force of क्त is to denote 'respect' etc.

Terms: समास-विभक्ति-6

The first member in the Dative -4th Case retains its accent before a Past Participle in क्त।

Terms: समास accent

A word having the sense of 'always' optionally retains its original accent before a Past Participle in क्त ।

Terms: समास accent
